nom: KORRES Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser

avis.texte: I have Lupus. With this condition you have to be extremely careful what products you use. Especially products that will strip the skin of moisture. Needless to say, I have tried so many different products. For me, KORRES Foaming Cream Cleanser saves my facial skin moisture from drying out. Of course, due to my condition, I do have to follow up with a thick cream moisturizer afterwards. But with this cleanser it DOESN'T have to be immediately after I cleansed my face.

I'm 50 but still deal with acne. This is my HG cleanser. It cleans well and leaves my skin moisturized, and most importantly, it doesn't break me out. It's expensive, so I've tried several times to leave it for other cleansers, but I come back every time. My skin looks best with this cleanser. It's worth every penny and I'm done trying other cleansers. I stock up whenever I find it on sale. Truly the best.

I tried so so many cleansers in the years of my skincare journey and everything was usually meh but this cleanser is perfect. I use it after micellar water as a second cleanser and it never irritiwtes my skin never dries it out lathers well and is just perfect and I have extremely sensitive skin with rosacea. I found double cleansing with oil to be harsh so this method is what i use at night and its gentle to use in the morning too. I have repurchased 3 times already
Love the products. First time using it and makes my face feel smooth after washing my face

I only gave it 4/5 stars bc of the scent. other than that, this is my second purchase so the smell isn't so bad that I won't use it. I don't feel like my skin is tight after using and it does a pretty good job with my waterproof mascara.

This face wash is a godsend, I've been using it for years! When it became more common for skincare companies to include various chemical exfoliants in face washes, moisturizers, and masks without explicitly stating which ones, this face wash was a great, neutral option that didn't clash with other products and cause chemical burns. It also removes makeup better than some face washes specifically marketed for makeup removal!
very clean and the biggest thing is it's very concentrated, you need maybe a dime size of product.

this face wash is a must have!!!I have been using this for a few months now and it never dissapoints me!!it stars off creamy like a lotion kind of texture but once you rub it together it turns into a nice foamy cleanser.If you are wondering weather this is actually a good cleanser it definitely is and you should see if it works for you!!! I have oily to combination skin🙂

This has become my go-to facial cleanser which I come back to no matter what other products I try. A small amount builds into a luxurious creamy foam lather that feels so soothing. I have extremely sensitive skin but this does not irritate it one bit and my face feels so soft, smooth, clean after rinsing, with no tightness, dry patches or flakes that other cleansers often give me. I've also noticed it calms down my redness slightly. The tube lasts ages because of the tiny amount you need - honestly if you're using more than a pea size it's too much. The scent is mild but very pleasant; it doesn't smell like Yoghurt like the Korres Superdose face mask if you're wondering. For me this is worth purchasing full price because my skin adores it.

Been using this cleanser since 2018 (i think!) and any time i stray, i come running right back. Gentle foaming cleanser with a probiotic element. If you get red spots on your forehead, this will clear it up 90%. Sometimes struggle with mascara but nothing a double cleanse and some warm water can't work at.

Giving my honest review !! I personally think is a must have ! The reason im giving it 5 instead of 4 stars is because the only problem i have is my face is a lil tight n dry after the wash , but nun a lil moisturizer cant fix and besides ur supposed to use moisturizer anyways ! I feel like this definitely removes my makeup even tho i use mid natural makeup nun too heavy . I also pair this with a face glove and works perfect .
I have very sentive skin this product works great My skin is softer

I bought a mini set that included this to keep at my boyfriends house & when I was staying at his place consistently, my skin cleared up so much. I recently bought the full size and I've gone from uncontrollable acne to clear skin in a matter of a few weeks. You also dont need much of it and itll take off a full face of makeup. A must have in my routine forever.

I bought this face wash on sale. It has been the best face wash I have tried. I have acne prone, oily, and dry patches on my skin. This works excellent for all of my issues. Its going to hurt, but I will repurchase at full price because it is that good.
Was very drying when i first trued it but i didnt think much of it and tried it again a fee days later and i broke out :((( but it did make my skin feel very clean dry but clean

avis.titre: Don't Judge a Book by its Cover, like I almost did
avis.texte: A coworker recommended this to me after I told her my trusty Cerave was no longer working for me. My face looked dull and I didn't get that deep clean and moisturizing feeling I initially had. I was skeptical at first of Korres because I have dark brown skin (that I didn't see portrayed on their website) and eczema that is constantly trying to appear on my upper lip. I always give a new product two months to give my skin time to get used to the product before deciding to discontinue. It has now been four months and I am in LOVE. The consistency is just like greek yogurt but its light and refreshing. My face is no longer is dull, its not stripped of its moisture, it is supple, and I feel clean and ready for the rest of my skin care routine. I recommend washing your face with cool/cold water with this product. I feel it works better and it soothes my skin at the same time ;) Especially To all my dark skin girlies, give this product a shot!

I bought this cleanser during the ulta spring sale and im SO GLAD I did! It true has done wonders for my skin, as someone who has struggled with acne most of my life (i'm 21) this was a game changer. I love that its not too stripping on the skin but does a good job of cleaning the skin. I cannot recommend this enough!

we have gone through 3-4 of these in the past year because both my husband and i love it! we have complete different skin types, i have dry skin and he has oily. it is gentle and my skin feels so hydrated after using it!
Love tgis cleanser. High quality at a very reasonale price. Please bring it back to stores.
I have been using this for like 7/8 years. It's the absolute best. I've tried everything. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this does not dry my skin out at all. Highly recommended.

I reeeaallly wanted to like this product, but unfortunately if you have sensitive skin this is most likely not the product for you. I had relatively clear skin, but during the winter i struggle with dry skin so i tried this and i regret it. My skin broke out terribly. Because it can take some time for our skin to adjust to a new product, i continued to use but it just kept getting worse. After a month of this product, when i took it out of my routine my skin started clearing up. This is an expensive product that is definitely a risk if you have sensitive skin.

I love this cleanser! I've been using it for about 1.5 years, and it does such a great job of removing impurities without stripping my face and leaving my skin dry (I live in Colorado so dry skin is always a challenge). I'd say my skin is somewhat sensitive and prone to redness, and this has never irritated my skin.
This cleanser is hands down the best! It's tough enough to remove makeup, yet gentle for sensitive skin. Leaves skin soft and beautiful!

Very soft, gentle cleanser and cleans very well. I use it as my second step after oil cleanser. My sister who has very dry and sensitive skin loves this cleanser very much too (unlike her, I have oily skin and loved it too). Would buy again ❤️

My skin is combination but now in my 30s, it is more dry. I also have rosacea and my skin is very sensitive. I usually cannot do foaming cleansers at all because as I've gotten older, they are just too drying. I'm amazed that this is a foaming cleanser that actually feels moisturizing to my skin, not drying at all. It also smells SO good to me. I can't even describe the scent, almost like cloves or cardamom. I get so excited to use this cleanser.
Its my second day using this and ive noticed a great difference. I usually have redness on my cheeks ans it has calmed down immensely. Such a great cleanser! Not an overwhelming scent. Game changer!
I have super sensitive combo skin and this cleanser works perfectly for me, it doesn't foam up a lot but it cleanses well without drying my skin out.

This is the cleanser I recommend to everyone and anyone who has sensitive skin, or even normal/combo skin. It's a water activated foaming cleanser, so bubbles galore if you put a bit too much. The scent isn't too strong, it may even be unscented and I'm just oblivious. This is one of the only cleansers that doesn't leave my face feeling dry! Absolutely reccomend using the DHC Deep Cleansing Oil before hand to remove makeup. I'll wear a full face of makeup, with waterproof mascara and these two will remove them without ANY makeup wipes!

I have very sensitive skin and this does wonders I absolutely love it. i used it for a month and then stopped for a month after to see the changes and it's definitely noticeable. Definitely recommend !
Its hard finding gentle products ther clean well and this one is it. I hate it is never in a store and i have to order online but i love it. Soothes my dry skin.

I just bough my fifth bottle of this cleanser- it's so good! I have very sensitive skin and struggled with acne for a long time and this product worked wonders for my skin. Since using it, I no longer get full face breakouts. It does an excellent job of removing makeup and buildup without overly stripping my skin. My skin feels soft, hydrated and glowy after I use this cleanser. I would recommend it to anyone!!

I got this on a whim and I will absolutely be buying again when I run out! It's super gentle and I've always had issues with red skin and this cleanser has almost completely gotten rid of my concerns in just under a month, with noticable difference after a couple washes! A little goes a long way as well, and it gets off my waterproof liner with no issues
Ive never had an allergic reaction to a facial cleanser until now. 2 days later and still have hives forming on my face and neck. Only now do i see reviews complaining of the same.
this is my holy grail cleanser. there's a very light scent which i love, it's not drying and cleanses well.

This face wash is so awesome. Yes, its pricier than the drugstore options, but I only need a pea sized amount for my whole face and neck, with suds to spare. Great for 2nd cleanse after oil cleanser or balm on heavier makeup days or alone. Even removed SPF.
I love it because it doesn't dry out my skin and at least my skin feeling soft and hydrated

I really like this cleanser so far. the only con I have is that it's not very good at taking off makeup, even after a 2nd cleanse. I have very dry/dehydrated skin and it doesn't irritate it. it actually helps the redness and is left feeling soft
Worth every penny. I could 100% see the benefits, it cleans so well, and lasts SO long. I've tried out many cleansers and this is excellent for my normal/combo skin.

avis.titre: Love this face wash for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a couple of years now. I knew I had a great product but sometimes you don't appreciate what you have until it's gone. I ran out a few days ago and my face is screaming. It's so red and dry. My skin type is oily and I have rocesia. I'll be stocking up on this product and be sure not to run out again.

I had such high hopes for this. It has so many beneficial ingredients and says it's safe for even the most sensitive skin….then they completely ruined it by adding fragrance. I can't use any products with fragrance bc it irritates my face so this is completely useless to me. I should have checked the ingredients before hand but I assumed with the high ratings and "safe for all skin" it wouldn't have added skin irritants.

avis.titre: Soft, gentle cleanser light clean smell
avis.texte: This is my every other day cleanser. I switch between an exfoliating cleanser and the next day this for gentle cleansing. It smells divine! Such a light clean scent and doesn't leave a smell after rinsing! It is creamy, foams well and my face feels so refreshed after this. Soft and supple skin. I am mid-30s with dry skin.

I was skeptical about purchasing this, my skin has been super dry around my tzone area and I tried other brands and most just made it worse. This one leaves my skin feeling so fresh and clean and not drying at all, it also helped with my redness in the tzone area.

i have been consistently coming back to this face wash for almost 5 years now…. nothing else compares! it leaves my skin feeling clean/hydrated and is gentle enough for rosacea and sensitive, reactive skin.
Unfortunately this product did not work well for my skin. It caused irritation & redness. I have sensitive skin in general.

avis.titre: Sad it didn't work for me
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this! But after a week it made my skin breakout so bad. :( my skin did feel clean after I washed my face with it, but i also had zits all over my face.
This is my go to cleanser. It removed all traces makeup including two coats of mascara without stripping the skin. All with a pea size amount. I love it.
One of my favorite cleansers. It gets all of my makeup off without being drying.

My new holy grail cleanser that I will repurchase forever… great for all skin types. Effective enough to remove makeup and use on all skin types, gentle enough you can use around your eyes and doesn't dry your skin out!

avis.titre: It's as great as everyone says
avis.texte: I would just buy it. Esp if you have fry sensitive skin. I react to everything, and when I say that I really do react to most face washes. I can only use a handful and most have been discontinued. So I've been looking for a new one and I'm so happy I found this. Sulfate free most importantly.

At this price point, this cleanser is lackluster. I don't feel like it truly cleansed my skin and I feel like I could have had a more luxurious but still gentle experience with the philosophy cleanser or a similar gentle experience for a lower price point with Cetaphil. It did last long and was gentle, but I feel like other brands do a better job or are similar but more affordable.

avis.titre: I loved it more than expected
avis.texte: I do a two step cleanse every night and this is a staple now. My skin doesn't feel dry but feels clean after using. It smells amazing and doesn't take a lot of product.
It's amazing skin care line my skin is really sensitive and work perfectly fine I will buy it again.

I first saw someone use this on Instagram so I decided to try it out and omg I love it so much I bought a second one once I saw it was on sale for the 21 days of beauty. It's so gentle but foams up amazingly and makes your skin feel SO SMOOTH AND SUPPLE. I love the smell of it too. I really don't have any complaints about it. I've used so many different products and I'm known to switch up cleansers all the time, but I think I found the one

I have acne prone skin and I recently had a terrible hormonal breakout. Any cleansers made for acne even with moisturizer, dries the ever loving heck outta my face and makes it itch. This is full of pre and probiotics and I've realized using a cleanser with those in there is what really helps with me acne. Face redness has improved too. It's going to last forever too worth the higher price point!

The only cleaner I use on my 8 year old daughter. She was breaking out and I tried the other usual dermatologist recommended cleaners but she still had breakouts. I got this thru a subscription but have repurchased from Ulta. Her complexion is soft, glowing, and pimple free! No irritation and no drying effects. I hope this works thru her teens❤️
It's non drying and is a pretty foaming cleanser. Nothing to write home about, I'm using it up because it's non irritating but I won't repurchase.

Korres is an amazing skin care line. I'm 54 and this wash is amazing. I use a small amount with a light exfoliating sponge. My face looks amazing. I also use their moisturizer and some other skin care. I've had no issues.

If you are looking for a basic cleanser that won't strip, exfoliate, brighten, or do anything fancy, this is it. It cleanses the skin. That's it. My face doesn't feel tight after, but doesn't get greasy within an hour either. I really like it.

I've been using this product almost a month. It's helped with redness and leaves skin clean and soft. I was surprised at the tiny amount needed to get lots of foam. I only have to single cleanse using this as well. I will definitely be purchasing again.
Super moisturizing, doesn't strip my skin like other cleansers. Helps prevent dry patches around my nose and chin.

avis.titre: Got this on sale. Would definitely buy it again
avis.texte: I use this product both night and day. I have combination skin with it being oily in the summer and dryer in the winter. So far I love have lightweight it is but so powerful at the same time it really cleans my face and gets all my makeup off !

I have dry skin and wanted a cleanser that wouldn't make my skin feel stripped. I found this and omg I love it!! It's cream which is perfect I love the way it makes my skin feel. The smell is so nice, personally I really like it. It also lasts a looong time which I love. This is def worth the money I love it
discovered this while on sale and decided to try. now my fave cleanser. doesn't strip but foams and cleans and even removes face makeup. by far the best face wash I have used in a long time.
A teeny tiny amount of this lathers up quickly! It's really gentle on the face and it does the job for a good cleansing! I love it!

this cleanser is soap free and contains pre and pro-biotics. takes makeup off easily, and doesn't strip your skin like other cleansers. super good for acne. a pea sized amount is all u need. have bought several times.

I love this cleanser. I'm on a retinoid and have sensitive skin so this really helps my skin keep its moisture. It's my favorite cleanser I've ever used. Giving it 4 stars though because I wish it was fragrance free :/
My skin feels clean without being stripped of moisturizer! Really creamy and foams up nicely for a satisfying wash. Great for dry winter skin.

I received this cleanser as a free gift for purchasing other Korres products. I love how I only need a tiny amount yet it lathers up so well, plus the scent is very light (dislike heavily fragrances on my face) and nice. Skin feels clean but moisturized after using, so I will definitely be purchasing the big bottle once I get low.
I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea. This cleanser has never, ever caused my skin to react negatively. Just a little bit goes a long ways and the tube lasts a long time.

I've tried many face washes and this one is by far the best I've ever used! A little bit goes a long way. It cuts right through the makeup and takes everything off. My face usually breaks out when I try any new face wash but it did not with this one. That's a win in my book!
If you had a break out reaction.. it has a few comedogenic ingredients so that might be why! •corn starch •chlorella vulgaris extract

i've been using this product for a few weeks now, and so i feel confident in saying that this is a truly solid product. it removes light makeup (blush and brow gel) very well, though anything on the heavier side can require a double cleanse, either twice with this, or an oil-based cleanser before this one. i'm not a huge fan of foaming cleansers, but that's on me, as 'foaming' is literally in the name. it can burn the eyes a little bit, but overall i haven't had any sensitivity to this product. i'm pretty leery about any 'probiotic' skin products, as i'm SUPER acne-prone, but i haven't had any extra breakouts resulting from this product, which is always a win. not drying or stripping, though not exactly 'nourishing', but that's more the job of the serums and moisturizers you layer post-cleanse. overall, this is a great product, and while i probably won't repurchase, at least for now, i wholeheartedly recommend.

I have combination, easily stressed-out skin that has never been happy. I got this in an Ipsy bag a couple of years ago, and this is SO amazing! I never looked back! My skin absolutely CRAVES this, and every wash feels so good and so calming and refreshing. My skin breathes, feels soft, and doesn't feel tight or like it's cracking when I use this. It keeps my oily T zone and dry cheeks balanced with a beautiful glow. I wear glasses, and it does so well at keeping oil at bay that my glasses don't slip down my nose anymore! I won't use any other cleanser!
After trying this about 6 months ago it has become one of my favorite cleansers. I use it to double cleanse, or either for my single cleanse in the morning.
This is an extremely gentle, all around cleaner that keeps skin hydrated and well balanced. By far my favorite!

I first received as a sample and fell in love. I have used too many products in my life, some better than others. This product is just great: smells good but not overpowering, easy to apply, foams well but is easy to remove. Skin feels clean but not stripped or tight. Worth a try if you've never had the opportunity. For me, a great find.

I have very sensitive skin so finding something that works, but doesn't cause breakouts, rashes or swelling can be tricky. Korres cleanser thoroughly cleans my skin without drying it out or leaving any weird residue behind. It even completely removes mascara - as a Dior fanatic, this is no small feat. I credit Korres as an important part of my daily routine which keeps me looking years younger than I really am.

This cleanser is amazing for my oily cheeks and dry forehead. It is so soothing and rinses off easily, doesn't leave any film or greasy feeling. After rinsing, my face feels smooth and soft. I always use toner and moisturizer after cleansing, but this has made cleansing my favorite step of my routine! I would recommend to anyone! The scent is very light.

I absolutely love this face wash. I have been trying to find a good one for awhile and have tried a LOT of different ones. This one just feels so nice on the skin and has a light pleasant smell and doesn't dry my face. It's amazing!

This cleanser clears up my skin so well. It's a little pricey so last year I decided to try looking for another wash that keeps my oily and break-out prone skin clear. Went through 4 different face washes before throwing in the towel and deciding its worth every cent. Nothing keeps my skin so clear and glowing like this. I've always struggled with acne prone skin (yet too sensitive for benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid) but this face wash has finally made me love my skin.

I've tried SO many cleansers and this one is the best. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth. It doesn't have a strong smell and doesn't leave me feeling greasy like some cleansers do. Highly recommend! I've seen some people leave bad reviews because it doesn't remove makeup well, but this is NOT a makeup remover. I always remove my makeup with a different product first then go in with this cleanser.
Been using for a few weeks now and my skin has started breaking out. I'm 45 and maybe have had 10 pimples my entire life….I literally have 5 on my face right now. I will be returning

avis.titre: Bought on sale.. money well spent!
avis.texte: I bought this cleanser on sale and was kind of hesitant to buy it because a few people commented on how the smell was too strong. I decided to buy it anyway at my own risk and I actually really love it. It makes my skin so soft and clarified. If I wear makeup, I will rub coconut oil all over my skin/eyes and then cleanse with this. Works amazing.. my skin is not sensitive to the fragrance which is wonderful because it would be very sensitive with cheap products. I would repurchase at full price when I run out. I rotate this product with the Tula cult classic cleanser and the Confidence in a cleanser. Great addition to my skincare routine!
I wanted to like it, but it doesn't remove makeup or dirt very well, and it leaves a residue on the skin.

This is one of the best cleansers I've ever used in my life, and I have a lot of other faves but this is truly something else! It leaves my skin feeling super soft, while also making it feel clean without being stripping, and it smells so good! I have oily acne prone skin, and this didn't break me out. I've noticed that other cleansers make my acne look really bright red, but this cleanser doesn't do that and calms down the redness and inflammation. I'm so glad I discovered this by receiving a sample size from Ulta, which then led me to buy the full size during the 21 days of beauty sale!

I go through a lot of sample testing, but by far this is my favorite cleanser. Not only is it a lightweight feel, but the suds clean everything so you don't have to double scrub, absolutely no irritation to the eyes when using for makeup removal, and rinses off quickly instead of requiring multiple rinses. Such great efficacy that it has improved the appearance of redness, cleared some acne, and even toned my overall complexion without drying/irritation. Completely recommend.
Love the light consistency of it and that it doesn't leave skin greasy.

This cleanser is so nice on my sensitive skin. I was using philosophy for a really long time, which I loved but would never calm my redness. I got this one in an Ipsy subscription and I've been hooked since. I honestly didn't have high hopes for it at all because nothing ever seems to work. I'm so glad this did. I've been using it since and even purchased one from Ulta when I ran out. It's soft on my face and a little goes a long way. My redness has reduced significantly and I am confident enough now to walk outside without makeup on.

This face wash made my skin so soft but after a few days of use I started to break out a little. Not sure if it's the face wash or something else. I'm going to try using it again in a few days and see if the same thing happens.
For someone who suffers with redness and dry skin 🥰 like I do!! I could feel a difference within a week of using!! I highly recommend!!
I am obsessed with this. I got a sample to try and I couldn't get over how great it smelled and how nice it felt on my skin. I will be buying this over and over again.
I ordered this one when it was on sale just because I needed a new facial cleanser. I'm glad I did because it feels very nice and it hasn't irritated my skin. I definitely recommend this cleanser.

I received this cleanser as a promo with the purchase of another item. I am always hesitant to use various samples of cleansers on my face as my skin is very sensitive. But,,, I gave this a try and love it so much.. My skin feels so soft and looks refreshed! The scent is also very subtle.. which is nice. The promo with all the samples worked because I am now ordering 3 different products from the bag…. I love ULTA.. my favorite "pamper me" store!! 😉

I originally received a sample and have since purchased 3 more full size bottles. I love using this cleanser in the morning. It is so gentle, has a great lather with just the tiniest amount of product, even the smell is light and fresh. It is just a very pleasant experience using this on my very dry skin.

absolutely love this cleanser. got it during the 21 days of beauty and this is one of my fav cleansers. i currently use youth to the people kale cleanser but this one is just as good. i find it to be less drying. makes my face super smooth and soft. so glad i bought two. also, you dont need much, a pea size amount foams up really well. go buy it, if you havent already!
it smells like almond milk, & it cleanses OK, but it irritates my eyes badly.

I got this as a free sample. It has a nice creamy texture, and a beautiful smell, but these are part of the problem. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this made me break out in red, pimple-like bumps that took days to go away. I wanted to like it, but my skin said "no way."

I've been wanting to try this cleanser for months now and finally decided to give the travel size a try. Definitely worth it if you're not ready to take the plunge with the fuller size bottle. Cleanses really well and isn't stripping to the skin whatsoever. Is slightly scented but nothing overpowering; however would use caution if you have sensitive skin or limit to a few times a week. Great product overall!

I love trying new things, but have always had an affinity for Korres. I tried this earlier in the year when it was included in a 21 days of beauty sale and I have just repurchased my 3rd tube. My skin is not particularly sensitive, but tends to be dry as the weather gets cooler. This is light, moisturizing and leaves my face feeling clean.

avis.titre: Great for Oily and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have never found a cleaner I kept buying repeatedly when I ran out until this one. It has improved my skin and balanced it out. It is gentle and still able to get most of my waterproof eye makeup off. This container also lasts me awhile - you don't need to use much. I highly recommend to anyone to try! Korres has great products at an affordable price.
I found this cleanser 6 years ago and have been using the same one ever since! It is great for all skin types. I wouldn't change it for anything else.
Received this is a sample and it make my skin so soft and smooth. Makeup applied flawlessly. Must have

I feel like this is fairly comparable to checks and balances face wash. Even with combo skin, for a cleanser I wanted something that accommodated my dry areas assuming my Tzone gets oily from being dry. This cleanser works really well for evening this part of my skin while also maintaining my hormonal acne. Get the travel size as I did and I recommend if you're skin is similar to me. I've used frequent for a week now
I really like this product. I've had face washes that dry out my skin and this doesn't. Nice subtle, fresh scent.

I love this product. I received it from one of my Ipsy boxes and only started using it because my other cleanser ran out. I normally use the Cult Classic cleanser from Tula and I would say that they're about equal in consistency and effects that it had on my skin. I love that it is foaming, this makes it last forever. The Tula cleanser is foaming as well, but not as milky. I'm only halfway through the bottle and its been about four months. You should note that this is not a one stop shop. It is a great cleanser and it keeps acne at bay, but you will still need an exfoliant to get deep grime buildup.

I have really enjoyed this product, I am half way through my first one and everyday feels like the first day, it's not dull. I feel soft and clean, not harsh in fragrance and leaves me hydrated better than any other cleanser I have used.

I have really enjoyed this product, I am half way through my first one and everyday feels like the first day, it's not dull. I feel soft and clean, not harsh in fragrance and leaves me hydrated better than any other cleanser I have used.
So gentle and so amazing! My face feels extremely clean always after using this. Perfect morning cleanser
I will never buy a different face wash!! You can get all of your makeup off with using such a small amount of product and it leaves your face feeling SO soft. Love love love

This cleanser has cleared the congested areas on my face and improved the overall texture. It has a light clean scent. It does dry me out a little but with a little facial oil I'm good as new. I'm so glad I have found this cleanser!

I received a sample of this cleanser in an Ulta promo and used consistently for about a week or two. It has a nice, mild smell, good consistency, and works well to foam up using a face scrubber. I have other cleansers I like as well, but would purchase this one for future use/variety. My skin feels soft and clean and I did not break out.
Was disappointed in this as it's a cream cleanser, my face felt so dry even after moisturizer.
I like the foaming for my pours but the yogurt makes my skin soft.

i first got a tester of this cleanser in a birchbox, and i immediately fell in LOVE with it. everything from the minimalistic packaging to how well it lathers on my face. i have oily combination skin (oily in t-zone but normal on the cheeks), and usually when i switch cleansers, i get a pimple, but then it goes away after a few days. this cleanser gave me one pimple (that's just how my skin reacts to new cleansers lol), but after a while and once my skin got used to it, i noticed a brighter complexion, and my acne went down. i like how it is hydrating enough for my oily skin!! also bonus points because i have never had a face cleanser that actually leaves me hydrated after i get out of the shower!! because usually my regular face cleanser (when i use it in the shower) leaves me with a dry face, like it has stripped all my natural oils out of my skin. but with this cleanser, it doesn't dry me out!! (tip, always get the travel size or sample size first so you will know how your skin will react to it!! have a blessed day!)

avis.titre: Makes my face shiny and smooth!
avis.texte: I use this product once when I wakeup in the morning and once at night to take off my makeup + clean my face. I love it! It works very well. I do have to put my moisturizer (Pond's for dry skin) on afterward or else my face will feel very dry and taut, but ask for my dry patches -- they have dissipated!

I love love love everything about this. Gentle non soap cleanser, clean fresh scent, gentle on my skin and not expensive. I love it!
OMG!!!! I love this product, it smells great and since I don't put soap on my face it everything I need in a facial wash. I love it so much I have it on auto delivery :u1F970:
This cleanser is so nice. It is very pleasantly scented and leaves my combination skin very soft. I will definitely buy it again!

This is such a great cleanser! I've used it for years for my sensitive, oily skin. This is effective in cleaning the dirt, oil, and makeup off my skin but is so gentle! I've used it for years and don't think I'll ever use something else to cleanse my face.
